serialization_note.normalization: Discarded PowerShell extended string-provider metadata; source text restored from matching verified source bytes. UTF-8 JSON stores only the intended records.

rejected_attempts.reason: Cancellation fixture assertion included the initial held-entry acquisition in its metadata count. Fixed by capturing the baseline and requiring exactly four job queries; no assertion was relaxed.

Last native fixture omitted creating the directory required by the existing make_junction helper (OPEN_EXISTING). Uncaught fixture exception caused fast-fail 0xc0000409. Corrected explicit directory creation and scoped junction removal. Failed fixture byte/owner inventory and removal recorded; no failed run accepted.

build_interpretation: Initial Mac 63-step build compiled affected core/platform interfaces, new decoder/walk code, affected fixtures and both test executables (26.026 s). Final 12-step build (8.954 s) follows corrected alias tracking and fixtures; test 0.899 s. Current source hashes, compiled units, output records and case markers establish freshness.

Mac broad builds previously took 18.102/19.573 s for 54/52 steps; this 63-step workload has more interfaces/fixtures. Final 12-step update is smaller and its actual compiled inputs are retained. No duration-only freshness inference is made.

Linux final build/test 13.018/0.152 s and Windows 39.244/2.879 s follow prior broad builds. Drivers verify the 127-file manifest and gate tests on build success. The rejected Windows run reached the new last fixture; final corrected source passed all 49 suites.

Focused diagnostics compile all 31 core units, platform adapter, simulator, domain/native source-target and ancestor fixtures, and test host (38 units), without object caches. Final build/test 65.956/0.329 s Mac,158.187/0.137 s Linux,83.524/0.314 s Windows. This is a new fixture-set baseline; preceding different 38-unit set took 81.822/191.917/108.183 s.

Preliminary same-set Mac/Linux diagnostics passed before final alias and fixture corrections; their outputs were hashed and removed. Final corrected source was recompiled/rerun on all hosts. Native case coverage differs by Linux permission test and the pre-existing POSIX-only source-target symlink case.
All validation is UTC 2026-10-24; local milestone date is 2026-10-24. No GUI was launched.
guarantees: Parent references are metadata-only, independent of enumeration position, and obtained through held native objects. No original pathname reopen, cwd changes, content reads, writes, elevation or journal mutation.
POSIX fixed-component openat uses O_PATH on Linux and O_EVTONLY on Darwin with directory/no-follow/close-on-exec. Linux native permission fixture verifies no directory-list requirement.

Windows uses exact USN2/3 IDs selected by existing identity scheme, strict portable record bounds, full parent ID open using original child as hint, minimal metadata rights, no-recall/reparse flags, no backup flag, before/after ID and provider qualification.

Ancestor reports retain source/destination/all parent owners. ObservedSource and RepeatedDirectory are positive sequence witnesses; no NotDescendant/SafeToCopy outcome exists. Unsupported/denied/changed/unknown edges remain explicit.

Directory/step/cooperative time limits cover parent and repeat comparison work; completed replies and pending owners survive yields without repeated operations. Failure/exception/abandonment releases private staging while issued results retain independent ownership.
limitations: A sequence of native edges is not a simultaneous namespace snapshot, mount confinement, universal alias exclusion, current-name proof or operation permission. Execution-time name/edge/capability qualification remains required.
OS calls may block beyond cooperative slices. Descriptor limits may fail before configured caps; representation bounds are not process-memory/OS-handle guarantees.

USN support is optional and unavailable cases never become safe negative ancestry. Native Windows qualification is ReFS v3; v2 has deterministic decoding coverage, not a native NTFS qualification claim.
The simulator has declared graph parent semantics and fault injection, not native mounts, permissions, provider behavior or name-equivalence emulation.

WP-01 remains open for operation-specific capabilities, name equivalence, remaining inventories, large-view indexes, UI/worker integration and operation/execution safety integration. WP-02 not started.
